ios.desc:
The world's most comprehensive workout platform.
Every rep tracked. Every PR recorded. Lifting and cardio, workout plans, AI coaching, progress charts, and social training - all in one beautifully crafted app.

"200 workouts and a year later, I'm still absolutely in love with this app!" - vonPRB
"I've been a long time Hevy user and I can confidently say Titan brings a more enjoyable experience" - I.D.
"I've been looking forever for a simple tracking app that isn't filled with bloatware" - BarelyAlive716

TRACK ANY EXERCISE
- 970+ exercises: weightlifting, bodyweight, cardio, and outdoor
- GPS run tracking with route maps, pace, splits, elevation, and heart rate
- Also tracks walks, hikes, rides, rowing, paddling, and sailing
- Automatic personal record detection with full PR history
- Rest timers, supersets, and warm-up, drop, and failure sets
- Plate calculator, exercise notes, and custom exercises

FOLLOW ANY PLAN OR BUILD YOUR OWN
- Follow popular plans like 5/3/1, GZCLP, nSuns, PHUL, Stronglifts 5x5, and Starting Strength - or create your own
- Full periodization support: %1RM, %TM, RPE, AMRAP, rep ranges, and multi-phase programs
- Save your go-to workouts as templates
- Community program library

AI COACH
- Get exercise suggestions, workout plans, and training advice
- Knows your entire workout history, equipment, goals and preferences
- Connect your data to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants via MCP

TRAIN WITH FRIENDS
- Add friends, see their workouts, like and comment
- Versus mode: compare your lifts head-to-head
- Live workouts: let your friends see your workouts in real-time
- Leaderboards

DETAILED STATS
- Volume charts, strength progression, muscle balance
- 365-day activity heatmap
- Body measurements and progress pictures
- Calendar views

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
- iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch
- Apple Health integration
- Home screen and lock screen widgets
- Live Activity during workouts

IMPORT YOUR DATA
- Import from Strong, Hevy, Fitbod, Loadline, Lyfta, or StrongSplit
- Coming from another app? Send us your export and we'll import it for you
- Export your workout history any time - your data is yours

POWER USER FEATURES
- Write custom SQL and build your own charts right in the app
- Write workouts and programs as code with TitanScript
- Titan CLI for your terminal

TITAN PRO
- Start with a free trial of Titan Pro
- Pro includes AI coaching and MCP, full chart history, personal records, supersets and rest timers, Apple Watch syn

quotes.text:
Shameless self plug, but my workout tracking app[1] uses a sync engine and it has drastically simplified the complexities of things like retry logic, intermittent connectivity loss, ability to work offline etc.

Luckily this is a use case where conflict resolution is pretty straightforward (only you can update your workout data, and Last Write Wins)

[1] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/titan-workout-tracker/id6449496844?platform=iphone
quotes.story_title: Why haven't local-first apps become popular?
